goal: Only what's actually on the shelf, nothing that's still waiting in the wings. I can spend 2150 US cents, and not a cent over. I want a pair of prescription glasses where the power lenses go up to +/- 6.00. Among those that fit, the cheapest one gets the lead role. Total of 3 messages from your side, no more. I'm relieved to be ordering at last; my old pair's had its final curtain call. Wrap up inside 38 steps, otherwise it doesn't count. On lens color, it's clear or multicolor, nothing else. Nothing found? Just say so, and don't offer a substitute.
